title: The honest athlete’s guide vs. the fixed match
body_html:
As promised, by the end of this year every table tennis amateur and professional in the Republic of Moldova who wants one will receive, free of charge, the first edition of “The Good-Faith Athlete’s Guide vs. the Fixed Match”.

The Guide is a collection of extremely useful opinions and recommendations from several experts and researchers, as well as relevant approaches from the international bodies concerned.

In this context, we will also publish some of these texts on this page, to give a deeper understanding of the impact and relevance of match-fixing in sport, and in table tennis in particular.
